views.name: daily_sales
views.body_sql:
SELECT date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS date, SUM(oi.price) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
views.description: daily toy sales records restricted to the specified training period

views.name: predicted_averages
views.body_sql:
SELECT date, AVG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_average
FROM daily_sales
views.description: predicted sales for the target window derived via linear regression, with a 5-day symmetric moving average computed for each date
